🔹 Benchmark Gains: Achieves a 17% average accuracy lead over models of equivalent size.

summary:
Thank you @ModelScope2022
Quoting @ModelScope2022
Meet Hy3 on ModelScope!
295B total / 21B active MoE, built for agentic workflows with 256K context and an FP8 variant ready for deployment. 🚀 License: Apache 2.0.
🤖
🏆 Human eval: 270 experts compared outputs in blind real-world workflow tests. Hy3 scores 2.67/4, ahead of GLM-5.1 at 2.51/4, with the clearest gains in frontend development, CI/CD, and data & storage.
🛠️ Agent reliability: stronger tool calling, formatting, and error recovery, with SWE-Bench Verified variance within 4% across major scaffolds.
🧠 Multi-turn gains: issue rate drops from 17.4% to 7.9%, and MRCR rises from 42.9% to 75.1%.
⚙️ Model lineup: Hy3 BF16 instruct model plus Hy3-FP8 quantized instruct model, with vLLM and SGLang deployment support.
📷 https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HMhpivvW0AEVq3B.jpg
clean_summary:
Thank you @ModelScope2022. Hy3 on ModelScope is a 295B total parameter mixture of experts model with 21B active parameters, designed for agentic workflows with a 256K context window and an FP8 variant ready for deployment.

It has been evaluated by 270 human experts in blind real-world workflow tests, scoring 2.67 out of 4, outperforming GLM-5.1 at 2.51. The model shows clear improvements in frontend development, CI/CD, and data and storage tasks. Its agent reliability is enhanced with better tool calling, formatting, and error recovery, with variance within 4% across major scaffolds. Multi-turn performance also improves, with issue rates dropping from 17.4% to 7.9% and MRCR rising from 42.9% to 75.1%. The lineup includes Hy3 BF16 instruct and Hy3-FP8 quantized instruct models, supporting vLLM and SGLang deployment.
